source.value: Rippers Unmasked — Playtest Materials (Miasma), granted by the Miasma/Effluvia heroic skill

summary.value: You manipulate the elemental balance within the target's body.

system.description: You manipulate the elemental balance within the target's body. You deal (HR + 30) poison damage to the target, and this damage ignores Resistances. Then, if the High Roll of the Magic Check was 8 or higher, or if you have acquired the Pathogenesis Skill (Core Rulebook, page 183), the target suffers poisoned.
